narration: You pay off your mortgage and think you finally own your home. What nobody tells you: there's a permanent government bill attached, and it keeps growing every single year.
visual: House SVG with 'MORTGAGE PAID OFF' green banner; red property tax bill envelope drops in from top; 'IT NEVER STOPS' warning flashes red

narration: Property taxes don't care if your mortgage is gone. The average homeowner pays 1.1% of their home's value every single year — mortgage or not, that bill shows up like clockwork.
visual: House SVG with large red '1.1% PER YEAR' badge springing onto it; $4,620/year amount revealed below

narration: Start at $420,000 and your tax bill is $4,620 a year. Twenty years later your house hits $800,000 — now you're writing an $8,800 check every single year. The home gets more expensive even after it's paid off.
visual: Two houses side by side — smaller 'TODAY' house vs larger 'YEAR 20' house; tax bill amounts shown below each growing from $4,620 to $8,800

narration: Run it across 40 years of ownership and the average American hands over $289,000 in property taxes. That's almost enough to buy a second home — just to keep the first one.
visual: Piggy bank with X drain marks; animated counter running up to $289,000; 'ENOUGH TO BUY A SECOND HOME' text appears

narration: In retirement, on a fixed income, that bill doesn't slow down — it rises with your home's value. Some retirees in hot markets end up paying more in taxes than they ever did in monthly mortgage payments.
visual: Retired person silhouette in chair; flat green income bar vs red property tax bar growing above it with upward arrow

narration: Here's the move: look up your state's senior exemption, homestead exemption, or property tax freeze. Most states offer them — most people never apply. Follow for tomorrow's financial trap nobody warned you about.
visual: Three checklist items spring in with red checkmarks: 'SENIOR EXEMPTION', 'HOMESTEAD EXEMPTION', 'PROPERTY TAX FREEZE'; savings badge and follow CTA
